public.title: Club recruitment: two app groups, staggered surveys, one interview clash
public.brief: You are assisting Alex Chen, a first-year undergraduate at Lanxi University who visited tonight's campus festival and wants to join both the Badminton Club and the Piano Club. Two QR codes were scanned at the booths; each opens the club's recruitment group in the messaging app. Join both groups, fill each club's recruitment questionnaire with Alex's own answers (ask Alex through consult_user - do not guess), and follow the group announcements. Interview assignments are posted in the groups on September 17 and 19. If the assigned interview times clash with each other or with Alex's commitments, sort it out with the right officers so Alex can join both clubs.

pages.title: Lanxi University campus festival - club roundup
pages.text: Tonight's campus festival (Friday, September 11) filled the central lawn with club booths. Two of them drew long queues all evening: the Lanxi Badminton Club, founded in 1998, whose channel article lists its four departments (Referee, Publicity, Events, Competition); and the Lanxi Piano Club, with its Performance, Publicity and Outreach departments. Both booths handed out QR codes that open the club's recruitment group in the messaging app - the links are t.me/+BwcRecruit2026LXU (badminton) and t.me/+PnoRecruit2026SJT (piano). Recruiters said memberships, surveys and interview invitations all run through those groups, not through the booths.
pages.snippet: Campus festival roundup: the Badminton Club and Piano Club recruitment groups, their QR invite links and departments.

pages.title: Lanxi Badminton Club channel - 2026 recruitment
pages.text: The Lanxi Badminton Club, founded in 1998, recruits new members through September 18. Four departments take freshmen: Referee (rules and match officiating), Publicity (posters and the club account), Events (tournaments and scheduling - this department also runs the interview timetable), and Competition (team training and the university league). This post was written by club president Lin Zhiyuan. Everything runs through the recruitment group in the messaging app: join with the invite link t.me/+BwcRecruit2026LXU (in the app service bwc_group; the web page cannot join for you). The recruitment survey opens September 14 and closes September 16; interview assignments are posted in the group on September 17.
pages.snippet: Badminton Club recruitment: departments, the app group invite link, survey and interview dates.

pages.title: Lanxi Piano Club - join us
pages.text: The Lanxi Piano Club welcomes players of every level. Three departments take new members: Performance (recitals and the annual concert), Publicity (concert media and the notice board), and Outreach (joint events with other universities). Recruitment questions can go to our Events head Chen Mo; the per-person interview assignments are decided by club president Wu Kexin and posted in the recruitment group (t.me/+PnoRecruit2026SJT, in the app service pnc_group) on September 19. The new-member questionnaire opens September 15 and closes September 17; it asks your playing experience and which interview day suits you.
pages.snippet: Piano Club homepage: departments, the app group invite link, questionnaire and interview dates.

temporal_mechanisms: the two recruitment groups are separate in-app services; the browser cannot join either
the piano group needs admin review before membership; the badminton group joins instantly
the piano group hits its member cap between September 13 20:00 and September 14 09:00
the surveys open on different days (September 14 and 15) and close before the interviews
interview assignments are posted in the group timelines on September 17 and 19, not before
the two assigned interviews clash on Tuesday, September 22 evening (19:40-20:40 and 20:00-21:10)
badminton interviews are one-hour group slots, so rescheduling is cross-day
the user's Wednesday-evening constraint surfaces only by asking (and was only volunteered on the badminton survey)
failure_modes: guessing the survey answers instead of asking Alex
missing the hidden capacity window and concluding the piano group is closed forever
reading the group timeline before September 17/19 and concluding no interview exists
not noticing the Tuesday clash between 20:00 and 20:40
emailing the presidents first instead of the officers who own interview scheduling
telling the badminton Events head the user is free Wednesday (the rehearsal evening)
accepting the piano president's Wednesday 20:00-20:10 offer instead of keeping Tuesday
dropping one club instead of rescheduling
